title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from skeleton.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

artefact_date.description: What is the chart date, the checkpoint weekday the ages and slack are computed against, as YYYY-MM-DD?

extracted_at.title: Extracted at
extracted_at.description: When did the script run the tracker query, as an ISO-8601 timestamp within the checkpoint week?

owner_role.description: What role does the program PM who takes re-baseline decisions hold (e.g. program-pm)?

tracker_query.title: Tracker query
tracker_query.description: What tracker query (JQL, Linear filter, GitHub search) did the script run to extract the open dependency links?
